name: Coral Button Warrens
introDiscord: Round coral doors cover a warren carved beneath the Moonlit Reef.
introTwitch: Round coral doors cover a warren carved beneath the Moonlit Reef.

buttonshell-gate.name: Buttonshell Gate
buttonshell-gate.prompt: Tiny shell mosaics turn in the current beside three low passages beneath the coral.

left.message: Beyond Buttonshell Gate, a restorative current shaped by Coral Button Warrens gathers in a quiet basin.
left.fullHpMessage: The restorative magic of Coral Button Warrens finds no wounds to mend. You are already at full HP.

right.message: Within Coral Button Warrens, the right path from Buttonshell Gate reveals a hidden Moonkeeper cache.

forward.message: The water folds around Coral Button Crab, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

crimson-burrows.name: Crimson Burrows
crimson-burrows.prompt: Red reef walls knot together around a junction whose three routes vanish under carved ledges.

left.message: The water folds around Coral Button Crab, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

right.message: Beyond Crimson Burrows, a restorative current shaped by Coral Button Warrens gathers in a quiet basin.
right.fullHpMessage: The restorative magic of Coral Button Warrens finds no wounds to mend. You are already at full HP.

forward.message: Within Coral Button Warrens, the forward path from Crimson Burrows reveals a hidden moon-shell coffer.

clasped-reef.name: Clasped Reef
clasped-reef.prompt: Moonkeeper clasps line a vaulted pocket where three tunnels thread through dense coral.

left.message: Within Coral Button Warrens, the left path from Clasped Reef reveals a hidden Fae offering vessel.

right.message: The water folds around Coral Button Crab, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

forward.message: A quiet recess beyond Clasped Reef preserves a dormant Fae shrine, but offers no material reward.

boss-antechamber.name: Crownclasp Chamber
boss-antechamber.prompt: A powerful presence shifts beyond the final threshold while the surrounding reef falls still.

bossPromptDiscord:
You reach Crownclasp Chamber. The water tightens around an unseen guardian whose presence fills the chamber.
Use /yes to continue or /no to retreat for now.
bossPromptTwitch: Crownclasp Chamber: An unseen guardian stirs beyond the threshold. Use !yes to continue or !no to retreat.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Crownclasp Chamber. The hidden guardian remains beyond the threshold.

boss.revealText: The chamber answers with a surge of reef magic. Coral Crown Regent reveals itself!

completionText: Coral Crown Regent yields to the returning current. Coral Button Warrens settles into a quieter rhythm, and another route through the Moonlit Reef becomes clear.
